name: More menu (⋯ secondary actions)
description: The ⋯ menu for compact page heads, rows and editors: one IconButton that opens a framework popover menu with the secondary actions, closing on pick, outside tap, Escape, scroll or resize. Items take onPick (or onSelect), icon, disabled, title and danger; conditional items may be false or null. Two looks: ctx (context-menu look, opens towards the roomier side) and dropdown (right-aligned, at most 260 px). Harvested Nov 7 2026 (build library-harvest) from the byte-identical copies ten Dev Console plugins carried.

parts.label: Context-menu look
parts.description: The default look: fx-ctx popover under the button, opening towards the side with more room.

parts.label: Dropdown look
parts.description: The fx-dropdown popover, right-aligned with the button and at most 260 px wide.

parts.label: Danger items
parts.description: Items marked danger are drawn with the menu's danger style.

connections.label: Actions it opens
connections.description: The registered actions the menu's items run (a designer binds each item to one).

wizard.intro: A More menu: pick its look, then bind each item to an action.
